scripts.dev: concurrently -n SHARED,SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,magenta,blue "npm run dev -w @orbitpath/shared" "npm run dev -w @orbitpath/server" "npm run dev -w @orbitpath/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @orbitpath/shared && npm run build -w @orbitpath/server && npm run build -w @orbitpath/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @orbitpath/shared && npm run typecheck -w @orbitpath/server && npm run typecheck -w @orbitpath/client
